prompt: The largest tidal ranges, called spring tides, occur at new moon and full moon. What alignment causes them?

options.text: The Moon is at its closest point to Earth in its orbit
Earth is at its closest point to the Sun in its orbit
The Sun and Moon pull at right angles, cancelling each other out
The Sun, Moon and Earth line up, so the Sun's and Moon's tidal pulls reinforce each other

explanation: At new and full moon the Sun, Moon and Earth are in line, so solar and lunar tidal forces add together, producing higher high tides and lower low tides — a larger tidal range.
